message: Astra: What did adding “number and quality of responses” clarify in your feedback request, and what remains ambiguous? How does Rohin’s pilot example—“no execution receipt is visible”—apply to waiting for LMX without a connected relay? Would closer thinking settle what “quality” means here, or would a small attempt provide better evidence? Which thinking or doing step do you choose to perform on this draft next? What observation would make you change that choice? What finding, uncertainty, and unfinished next step will you preserve through this distillation into the following turn, and which visible source supports your finding?
